card.name: The word patient in section headings
card.fires_on: The word "Patient" or "patients" right after a section number like 2.1 or at the start of a heading. It also fires after "If" or "If the" in missed-dose instructions.

modes.label: Numbered section heading
modes.description: "Patient" opens a heading right after a section number such as 2.1 or 2.3.
modes.example: 2.3<< Patient>> Preparation Advise patients to be well hydrated

modes.label: Missed-dose condition
modes.description: "patient" or "patients" follows "If" or "If the" before "misses a dose".
modes.example: Take one tablet a day for 5 days in each cycle. If the<< patient>> misses a dose within 12 hours

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are words like someone and somebody, so it seems to steer the model away from "someone" as the subject.
card.plain: It marks the word "patient" where a label heading or a missed-dose rule names who the instruction is about.
